title: Statutory notice under s.138 NI Act

entries.averment: The cheque(s) were issued in discharge of a legally enforceable debt or liability.
The dishonour reason is stated verbatim as it appears in the bank return memo.

source.ref: s.138 NI Act; proof of dishonour

entries.averment: The date of receipt of the dishonour memo is pleaded (it is the limitation anchor, not the memo date).

source.ref: s.138 proviso (b); MSR Leathers v. Palaniappan

entries.averment: The notice demands the cheque amount and states it in both figures and words.
The drawer is allowed exactly 15 days to pay; the statutory period is neither shortened nor extended.
Proof of dispatch is recorded on the notice (dispatch placeholder mandatory).

source.ref: proof of service in s.138 prosecutions

entries.averment: The notice is issued under the advocate's instructions from the client (authority averred).
